description.fun: Plusle shorts out the current in its palms to make sparkly pom-poms, then waves them to cheer on its teammates, and it cries loudly when they lose. It's thought to dream of cheering even in its sleep. It climbs telephone poles to soak up electricity, and it's almost always seen with its partner, Minun.
description.guide: An Electric-type Pokémon marked with red plus signs, the counterpart of Minun; the pair were the partner Pokémon at the start of Pokémon Ranger. It cheers on its allies with sparkly pom-poms. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A plus-charged cheerleader that cries when its team loses
